passage:
A wetland near the city had been drained years ago for construction, but the land often flooded after heavy rain. The city decided to restore part of it.
Some residents thought wetlands were useless muddy places. Scientists explained that wetlands can hold water, support wildlife, and clean pollution naturally.
After restoration, birds returned. Flooding in nearby streets became less serious.
The wetland did not look as neat as a park, but it worked quietly.
The project changed how residents saw nature. A messy-looking place may be doing important work. Beauty is not the only reason to protect land.
